One of the annoying things about the low-IQ rightists who populate this site is they assume everyone else is as dumb as they are. 

I posted here that it would make more sense to idolize Denmark than Hungary, so various chuds are popping out of the woodwork to be like “hurrr durr you libs would hate Denmark’s immigration policies.” 

I know all about Denmark’s immigration policies — it was a deliberately well-chosen example to illustrate how bizarre, corrupt, and irrational the MAGA obsession wi

Anyways, here’s a good piece on all the campaign promises Mamdani has walked away from complete with former Burlington, VT mayor Bernie Sanders criticizing “armchair radicals” who don’t understand the practicalities of holding responsible office.

nytimes.com/2026/04/10/nyreg…

I don’t want to tell anyone “don’t worry about elected officials spouting nonsense.” 

Sometimes you really do get a huge fuckup like Sam Brownback or Brandon Johnson in office, but most wildly unworkable ideas get ditched because they are unworkable.

The exact same structural parameters apply to all kinds of insane ideas from all political orientations — as a back-bench legislator or a candidate for office, talk is cheap and people say stuff. 

But governors and presidents and mayors are reality-constrained.

Sometimes Trump does crazy and self-destructive things (see the Strait of Hormuz or Liberation Day) but precisely because this 100 million deportation idea makes no sense, even people who are not big Trump fans sharply discount it as a possible outcome.

Case in point, this administration has repeatedly promised “100 million deportations” which would require removing tens of millions of lawful permanent residents and US citizens, shrink the population by over 25% and crash the economy.
I see why it happens but business people seem to take an extremely literal approach to rhetoric from left-wing politicians that they would dismiss as naive or even hysterical if applied to Trump.
If you want to get obsessed with copying a European country, I would pick Denmark over Hungary.
